**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY) — Section 12**

- **Already met:** the software conformance warranty runs one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date (plus the acceptance period and any maintenance-covered period), comfortably above the 90-day fallback floor, and there is no general disclaimer swallowing it.
- **Fails fallback on two material terms:** no services warranty of any duration (Sections 4, 5, 9 and 10 contain no performance-quality warranty), and Section 12 states no remedy — Section 10(c) repair is only a best-efforts, maintenance-fee-conditional service, and the Section 7–8 money-back mechanic is confined to the acceptance period, is "in lieu of any other remedy" and terminates the Agreement.
- **Cure proposed (fallback, one insertion after p0086):** a 30-day professional and workmanlike services warranty plus an express repair/replacement-or-refund remedy for breach of the Section 12 warranties, leaving all existing text untouched.
